derivation: Per-source entity floors for the deploy.yml 'Verify harmonized output'
gate. Recalibrated 2026-07-29 against a per-source harvest of the 15
data repos on a tree of ammitto/ammitto main 541b0cf plus the three
open branches fix/pipeline-honesty, fix/output-integrity and
fix/ingestion-robustness. Each source was harmonized alone so no
failure masked another. Two derivation classes:
1. measured (au cn eu eu_vessels nz tr uk wb): floor(count * 70 / 100)
of that harvest, in INTEGER arithmetic — binary floating point makes
floor(1370 * 0.70) evaluate to 958 in jq 1.6 while the exact value is
959, so regenerate with integers or the floors drift by one.
70% tolerates normal delisting churn while still
failing on partial-source loss. Seven of these exit 0 and total
19756 entities; tr exits 1 (37 of 275 files carry blank local ids)
but the 238 that do transform are distinct entities, so its floor
is measured rather than provisional.
2. provisional (ca ch jp ru un un_vessels us): the source harvests 0
entities, and a floor of 0 would disable its gate. ca/ru ship no
harmonizable YAML, un/un_vessels have no input directory, ch and us
hold announcement-format YAML the transformer rejects, and jp's 101
files all carry blank local ids. Floors stay
floor(March-committed api/v1 count * 35 / 100), same integer rule;
the March stats double-count entities+entries (~2x), so 35% of March
approximates 70% of real.
These floors are deliberately unreachable: the gate stays red until
the data or the ingestion path is restored.
The 2026-07-28 calibration this replaces put jp and us in the measured
class at a floor of 1. Both counts were placeholder rows, not entities
— entity/jp/jp collapsed every jp record, and entity/us/unknown was the
whole of us — so a floor of 1 certified exactly the garbage the gate
exists to catch. tr's 239 was 238 entities plus one shared
entity/tr/unknown row and is corrected to 238.
ON THE MARCH-COMMITTED api/v1 BASELINE: its stats.json counts are
inflated (entities and entries are double-counted), but its aggregates
are NOT malformed and an earlier revision of this file wrongly said so.
Measured 2026-07-29 across all 15 files: 96550 of 96731 nodes carry a
bare `id` rather than `@id` — the pre-revamp schema, which is exactly
what the site's own useSanctionsData reads — and those 96550 ids are
ALL distinct, only 24 nodes resolve to a `/unknown` placeholder, and
93102 of 93423 name objects carry a non-blank full_name. What is
actually wrong with that snapshot is coverage: eu, ru and un_vessels
collapsed to one entity each against 11720, 1995 and 32.
Regenerate this ENTIRE file from the next reviewed full 15-source
harvest — do not hand-tune individual floors.
total_entities_floor = floor(green_total * 70 / 100), the seven sources
that exit 0; adding tr's 238 gives 19994, which is exactly the
deduplicated search-index row count of the same tree's combined run.
measured_entity_counts is documentation only; the workflow reads
source_floors and total_entities_floor.
REACHABILITY: the gate that reads this file cannot run at the pinned
gem SHA. harmonize exits 1 on ca/ru/un/un_vessels (no input) unless
the run passes --allow-empty, which deploy.yml does not, so the
workflow stops at the harmonize step before any floor is compared.
The counts above were also measured with three unmerged gem branches
applied; the pinned SHA alone still emits the placeholder ids they
remove. Both must be resolved before these floors gate anything.
derivation_command: ammitto harmonize --sources-dir <15 data-* clones> --combine --verbose, once per source so no failure masked another
reproducibility: NOT independently reproducible as recorded. The three branch SHAs above
are the tips that were measured; origin has since advanced past all
three (by 2, 2 and 8 commits at the time of writing), so re-running on
the branch NAMES will not reproduce these counts.
The 15 data-* repository SHAs were NOT captured at measurement time,
and those repos are updated by scheduled fetch runs, so fresh clones
will drift. Nothing here lets a third party reconstruct the harvest.
Consequently the arithmetic in this file is checkable but the counts
it derives from are not. The next regeneration MUST record the gem
SHA, every data-repo SHA, the exact command, and the retained run log
before these floors can be treated as an audited baseline.
partition: publishing_sources and pending_sources partition source_floors: every
key appears in exactly one list. publishing_sources are harmonized and
gated on their floors below. pending_sources are named in the harmonize
step's --allow-empty list, or omitted from its source list entirely,
because their input is missing or unusable upstream; the verify step
holds each at EXACTLY zero entities and no published aggregate, so the
day one of them harvests real data the gate fails and forces its floor
to be recalibrated before it is published. That is deliberately the
opposite of relaxing the floor to 0: a floor of 0 would accept both
zero and a half-restored source, this accepts only zero.
Measured 2026-08-05 against ammitto/ammitto main dead9f0 with the three
open PRs #35, #36 and #37 merged in, over fresh clones of all 15 data-*
repositories: publishing_sources harmonize 20031 entities and every one
clears its existing floor unchanged; every pending source harmonizes 0.
